نتكاشف (form VI)
# نَتَكَاشَفُ (natakāšafu) /na.ta.kaː.ʃa.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَاشَفَ (takāšafa)
# نَتَكَاشَفَ (natakāšafa) /na.ta.kaː.ʃa.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَاشَفَ (takāšafa)
# نَتَكَاشَفْ (natakāšaf) /na.ta.kaː.ʃaf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَاشَفَ (takāšafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
